name: Kulindadromeus
isnote: A basal neornithischian; no clade below Ornithischia is defined in this volume yet, and analyses (e.g. Fonseca et al. 2024) disagree on how basal neornithischians are related.
sum: A basal neornithischian of the Middle Jurassic of Siberia whose feather-like integument suggests protofeathers were basal to Ornithischia.
wsnote: Not given in the sources used.
holotype: INREC K3/109, from a layer of the Ukureyskaya Formation, Russia.
material: Not read in the sources consulted beyond the holotype.
biology: Not described in the sources consulted.
author: Godefroit et al. 2014
